company.name: Cobalt Survey
company.one_liner: Field data collection for environmental consultancies

problem.statement: Environmental consultants collect site data on paper and re-enter it later.

solution.description: An offline-first mobile app that syncs when signal returns.
solution.how_it_works: Offline-first capture on mobile, synchronising when connectivity is restored. No further detail.

product.demo_evidence: Three pilot customers are referenced, which implies something deployable; the deck shows no demo and does not state product maturity. This is an inference from the pilots, not a statement in the deck.

competitors_omitted_suspicion: The deck has no competition slide at all. Field data collection is a category with established mobile form and survey tools, none of which appear.

missing_sections: Market sizing of any kind — slide 4 contains a belief, not a number
Any evidence for the problem beyond its assertion
vague_language: 'We believe this is a large and underserved market' — the entire market slide, and it is a belief with no figure, no segment and no source
unsupported_numbers: There are no quantitative market claims to support or refute. The only numbers in the deck are three pilots and $750k.
deck_quality.notes: The defining feature of this deck is the absence of evidence rather than the presence of bad evidence, and the two should not be scored the same way. Nothing here is overstated: the market slide makes no numeric claim at all, and the traction slide says plainly that there is no revenue. For a pre-seed raise of $750k on a SAFE, thin revenue is normal and should not be penalized. What should be noted is thin evidence of demand — three pilots with no stated conversion intent, no pricing conversation, and no sizing of any kind. The right posture toward this deck is low confidence in both directions: there is not enough in it to support a positive assessment or a negative one, and any analysis that reaches a confident verdict from six slides containing one belief and three pilots is overreaching.
